themes.evidence: We are here for one purpose, to help build a better world, where every person is free to move and pursue their dreams.
We value service to each other and the world as much as to our customers.
Having played our part in everything from the birth of the middle class to the recent global pandemic, we serve the world with integrity and competence.

linguistic_shift: The tone has shifted to emphasize the company's role in society and its commitment to a better world.
analyst_notes: The company's purpose statement has been updated, but no other values have changed.
